==Dye==
[[Dye]] affects the entire sword. The handle's wrapping and the orb will dye to the color specified while the rest of the sword will dye differently. The only exception to this are black, gray, silver and white dye which will dye the entire sword to a similar color. The default color can be closely replicated using orange dye.
